finding.before: An isolated POST route returns request.get_json().
finding.diagnosis: For a parsed scalar string, direct Flask view return creates a text response, while the case expected a JSON response. The parser contract itself was correct, but the harness precondition could not produce the stated observable.
finding.after: An isolated POST route passes request.get_json() to jsonify so the parsed scalar is observable as a JSON response.

scope: Only the generated test precondition changed. Source requirement, input, action, parsed value, HTTP status and application code remain unchanged.
